findings.description: Zero-human-evidence reality is carried pervasively (frontmatter, read-first, TL;DR, S2 BLUF, S3, S6, S7, S8, S9, S10, S11) — confirmation, not a gap.

Merlin single-lab concentration carried fairly: S5 first-class with both denominators (50% all-cause / ~75% gut-IBD), >=70% flag, honest reduce-not-eliminate caveat; correctly scoped to the gut/IBD track.

Contested antimicrobial balanced: Cutuli positive + Songok 2018 independent null + originating-group concession of weak native activity; lands at LOW confidence; robust signal assigned to engineered/dimerized derivatives.

Monomer-vs-analogue discipline consistent: KdPT (acne) and alpha-MSH+(CKPV)2 (gout) and (CKPV)2 (vaginitis) kept off the KPV-monomer ledger across S1.8/S3.3/S7.2/S7.4/S11; no analogue finding laundered onto KPV.

Dual numbering: section-body local citation numbers (e.g. [3,in_vitro]=Land 2012 in S2.3) do not map to unified Bibliography numbering (where [3]=Land but [4]=KdPT etc.); disclosed in the bibliography header and attested by upstream Phase-4.25 reconcile, but not reconstructable by the end reader. Recommend a per-section crosswalk or renumber inline cites. Traceability friction, not mis-grounding.

S5.2 counts Cutuli (in-vitro-lead per S7.3/bibliography) and Bonfiglio (corneal) as 'in-vivo efficacy primaries'; self-disclosed in S5.6 as denominator-sensitivity that does not move the headline gut/IBD 75%.
Tone non-promotional throughout ('mechanistically attractive but clinically unproven'); the single enthusiasm point (PepT1-KO causal result) is correctly bounded as preclinical.

Overstatement traps all avoided: 12,000x framed as single-lab intra-study formulation comparison not general potency; gut-IBD not oversold as near-clinical; vendor LD50/>=100 mg/kg marked UNVERIFIED; FDA Cat-2 removal repeatedly stated as not approval / not lawfully compoundable.

Regulatory/WADA accurate: FDA Cat-2(2023)->removed ~15 Apr 2026 (nomination withdrawn, 1 of 12)->unlisted pending PCAC 23-24 Jul 2026, removal!=approval, PCAC non-binding; WADA not named but S0 catch-all at all times, contrasted with BPC-157/S2; FDA line-item honestly conceded as multi-source-corroborated not primary-quoted.

Optional: report states the Apr 2026 removal was nominator-withdrawal but does not draw the inference that an administrative/commercial withdrawal is a negative-to-neutral signal, not vindication; the existing 'removal != approval' framing already prevents the dangerous misread.
